Al Haramain Amber Oud is the collection that made this Arabian perfume house famous, and you will find many of its editions here. These are warm, long-lasting eaux de parfum, each with its own twist on amber.

The Amber Oud editions

The Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition (£29.99) opens with melon and pineapple before a creamy amber and vanilla base. The Amber Oud Tobacco Edition 60ml (£34.99) is sweeter and spicier, with tobacco and woods. Ruby (£41.99) brings saffron and jasmine, Black (100ml, £41.99) is smoky with leather and resins, Bleu (£35.99) is fresh and aromatic, and Carbon (£34.99) is a clean, green take for men. White Edition, the original Amber Oud 60ml and Amber Musk 100ml are here too, plus the Extreme Gold Edition Extrait de Parfum at £37.99.

L'Aventure and Detour Noir

The Al Haramain L'Aventure line offers fresher 100ml bottles from £24.99. The original L'Aventure (£27.99) is clean and citrusy, while Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense (£30.99) adds elemi, jasmine and patchouli. L'Aventure Gold and L'Aventure Femme suit women who like fruity florals, and L'Aventure Blanche is a crisp unisex option. Al Haramain Detour Noir 100ml (£19.99) is a warm blend of vanilla, lavender and almond.

A natural shampoo cleanses with gentle, plant-based ingredients and leaves your hair soft rather than squeaky. Our edit has seven shampoos and kits from the Indian natural brands Vilvah and Deyga, from £12.99, made with rice water, goat milk and herbs and free from harsh sulphates and parabens.

Gentle formulas for every hair type

Deyga's Rice Water Shampoo (£13.99) provides a gentle, natural cleanse without harsh chemicals and adds shine and smoothness. Vilvah's Goat Milk Shampoo (£12.99) uses goat milk and pea protein to soften hair and reduce frizz, and the Goat Milk Shampoo 250ML (£15.99) cleanses without stripping natural moisture. If you are after a paraben free shampoo or a sulphate free shampoo in the UK, these Indian-made formulas are a good place to start.

Herbal care for the scalp

Vilvah's Herbal Shampoo 250ML (£15.99) and Herbal Shampoo for Dandruff Control (£12.99) bring neem, tea tree, rosemary and black pepper for a balanced-feeling scalp. Deyga's Anti Dandruff Shampoo 220ml (£14.99) uses botanical extracts. See our shampoo for dandruff page for more.

Shampoo and serum together

The Vilvah Shampoo & Hair Serum Kit (£25.99) pairs gentle cleansing with a lightweight serum to help with frizz and dullness. It is a neat starter set if you are new to the brand.

Swansura is an official UK partner of Vilvah and Deyga, so every bottle is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, with free delivery on orders over £40. Browse the Vilvah and Deyga brand pages, or add a matching conditioner.

Everyday essentials

For a natural face wash, Deyga's Vitamin C Foaming Face Wash (£15.99) cleans with a soft micro-foam. Rooted in Ayurveda

Kits and routines

Vilvah's kits make it easy to start. The Oil Control Kit (£32.99) suits oily and combination skin, the AM Brightening Kit (£39.99) is a fresh morning routine, and the Everyday Care Milk Kit (£48.99) keeps things gentle. Deyga's Vitamin C Daily Glow Combo (£30.99) pairs vitamin C care for brighter-looking skin.
